channel.title: Cabo Verde - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Cabo Verde, every source cited.

item.title: Cabo Verde ranks third in African governance index
item.description: The nation scored 70.3 points in the 2026 Ibrahim Index of African Governance, maintaining its position.

item.title: Cape Verde informal workers shun social protection
item.description: Only 5.1% of estimated self-employed workers in Cape Verde were covered by social security in 2023.

item.title: Cape Verde president rallies supporters for re-election bid
item.description: Jose Maria Neves seeks a second term in the November 15 presidential election, promising salary increases and reforms.

item.title: Cape Verde fuel prices drop in November
item.description: Gasoline and diesel costs decrease, but industrial fuels and kerosene rise.
